services.name: Fishing Derbies
services.desc: Welcome to Miller’s Landing, a proud, family-owned operation run by third-generation fishermen on our original homestead, everyone is welcome aboard-first-timers and seasoned anglers alike. We’ve been fishing these cold Alaskan waters since before the company existed, and we bring that hard-earned local knowledge-and all the right tools-to every trip. Use the calendar to see what’s available for your dates. Then scroll down to explore our full lineup of fishing charters and other trips in and around Seward. services.name: Remote Cabins
services.desc: Discover the exceptional lodging options available at Miller’s Landing, where we pride ourselves on offering competitive pricing alongside unparalleled customer service to meet all your accommodation needs in Seward. Immerse yourself in the beauty of Alaska by exploring our diverse selection of cabins, houses, and enchanting bed and breakfasts, each poised to be the starting point of an unforgettable Alaskan adventure. Please note, all cabins at Miller’s Landing are subject to a one-time cleaning fee per stay, ensuring your accommodation is pristine upon arrival. services.name: Package
services.desc: Miller’s Landing is offering an affordable housing and meal package for anyone taking the wilderness First Responder Class. On-site amenities include laundry services and a shower house, both operated with convenient tokens, so you’ll have everything you need without having to leave the property. The location offers a true retreat, with the option to explore Seward or grab dinner in town when you’re ready to venture out. services.name: Kayak Rentals
services.desc: Designed for folks looking to rent kayaks from us and gain more information and skills when it comes to kayaking in and around Seward and the National Park. For ages 16+ Miller’s Landing is an excellent place to learn sea kayaking basics and safety. We offer a Seward, AK sea kayaking class which provides a complete introduction to self-rescue techniques, and using the ACA’s standards, paddling criteria, and activities to make sure you are ready to kayak camp in the National Park or do an open water crossing from Caine’s Head to Fox Island. services.name: Campsites in Seward, Alaska
services.desc: Experience camping on the shores of Resurrection Bay at Miller’s Landing, just 2.5 scenic miles from downtown Seward. Surrounded by mountains, ocean, and abundant wildlife, our campground is the perfect basecamp for fishing, kayaking, hiking, wildlife viewing, and exploring Kenai Fjords. Choose from tent sites, RV sites, camping cabins, and our waterfront Miller’s Landing North (Annex), which offers tent camping and 30-amp RV hookups. Guests enjoy access to hot showers, laundry facilities, restrooms, and our on-site store, while the Annex is just a short five-minute walk from these amenities. Getting here is part of the adventure.
